name: jarvis-app
description: The Jarvis desktop app: an ambient voice assistant for the Mac, and Eden Code, its coding app (flavor.js).

scripts.package: node scripts/bake-home.js && electron-packager . J.A.R.V.I.S --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=build/icon.icns --extend-info=build/extend-info.plist --app-bundle-id=com.bshventures.jarvis --ignore=^/dist --ignore=^/scripts --ignore='^/build/(?!eden-code(/icon-1024\.png)?$)' && sh scripts/finish-app.sh
scripts.install-app: npm run package && rm -rf ~/Applications/J.A.R.V.I.S.app && mkdir -p ~/Applications && cp -R dist/J.A.R.V.I.S-darwin-arm64/J.A.R.V.I.S.app ~/Applications/ && npm run package:eden-code && rm -rf ~/Applications/'Eden Code.app' && cp -R 'dist/Eden Code-darwin-arm64/Eden Code.app' ~/Applications/ && open ~/Applications/J.A.R.V.I.S.app
scripts.install-eden-code: npm run package:eden-code && rm -rf ~/Applications/'Eden Code.app' && mkdir -p ~/Applications && cp -R 'dist/Eden Code-darwin-arm64/Eden Code.app' ~/Applications/ && open ~/Applications/'Eden Code.app'
